payloads.players: docs/rink/data/<season>/skaters.json -> players{pid}.values{id} (pct_pos{id} = percentile v forwards or defencemen; pct{id} v all skaters); goalies.json -> players{pid}.values{id}, pct{id}
payloads.player_pages: docs/rink/data/players/<pid>.json -> seasons[].values{id}, current.onice, current.rapm, similar[[pid, name, team, distance]]
payloads.teams: docs/rink/data/<season>/teams.json -> teams{abbr}.units{id} (pct{off5, def5, pp, pk, goalie, rating}); points % = season.json -> standings.rows[].p_pct

method.seasons: 2010-11 to 2025-26 regular seasons (16 seasons, 15 season pairs); 2009-10 payloads not built; 2026-27 in progress, excluded
method.yoy: Pearson r between seasons t and t+1, values z-scored within season and peer group, both seasons qualified
method.split_half: odd v even games within season (uncorrected r, Fisher-averaged across seasons; split_half_r_sb = Spearman-Brown 2r/(1+r)); game-level data from data/nhl/cache/player_games, xg_shots, c/tg_<S>
method.m50: n_bar x (1 - r) / r with r the uncorrected split-half r at mean half-season sample n_bar; year-to-year r at the mean season sample where no game-level split exists (an upper bound: it includes real change in talent)
method.predictive: Pearson r of the metric in season t with the target in season t+1 (same peer group, both qualified); sign oriented so a positive r means the better direction (per 'direction') goes with more future value. Skater target: next-season GAR/60 (the site's own value model, a single-season measure); also next-season points/60 and 5v5 on-ice xG differential/60. Goalie target: next-season GSAx/100 unblocked attempts. Team target: second-half points % from first-half metrics (also second-half goal differential/game and next-season points %).

benchmarks.teams: first-half points % -> second-half points % 0.512; first-half goal differential/game -> second-half points % 0.528

groups.peer_group: group == 'F' (pos C, L, R); compared within season (pct_pos)

minimum.note: payload flag: 250 5v5 minutes x (team games / 82); percentiles also need the metric's own floor (reference.floors) and Value metrics 200 minutes all situations

gar.name: Rink value (GAR / WAR)
gar.about: Our goals above a replacement-level player: even-strength impact, power play, penalty kill, finishing and penalties, and the wins they are worth.

rapm.name: RAPM
rapm.about: Regularised adjusted plus-minus on our expected goals: a skater's isolated effect on xG for and against at 5v5.

xg.name: Our expected-goals model
xg.about: Our shot model: the chance each unblocked attempt becomes a goal, from distance, angle, type and the play before.

gsax.name: Goalie model (GSAx)
gsax.about: Goals saved above expected from our shot model: saves made over what an average goalie would make on the same shots.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Our game model's team rating, with 5v5 offence and defence, special teams and goaltending parts.

proj.name: Projection model
proj.about: Rest-of-season points, goals and on-ice xG share from recency-weighted rates regressed to the position mean.
